Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015a; Marta-Simões et al., 2016): BAS-2 is a 10-item measure designed to assess individuals' acceptance and respect for their bodies, regardless of its appearance (e.g., "I take a positive attitude toward my body" or "I appreciate the different and unique characteristics of my body").

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Body Mass Index (BMI): Participants' BMI was calculated using the Quetelet Index from self-reported participants' height and weight (Kg/m2 ).

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the self-report instruments used in the study: BMI (calculated from self-reported height and weight), the Figure Rating Scale (FRS), the Cognitive Fusion Questionnaire-Body Image (CFQ-BI), the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). It also notes that Cronbach's alphas for study variables for two groups are presented in Table 1.
